CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.KOL_EksportDysp (@GidNumer int,@GidTyp int,@OpeNumer int, @MagKod varchar(5)) AS BEGIN if @GidTyp in (1089,1601,1602) begin declare @wart varchar(10) set @wart='<BRAK>' if exists(SELECT * FROM CDN.Magazyny JOIN CDN.MagObszary ON Mgo_MagTyp = Mag_GidTyp AND Mgo_MagNumer = Mag_GidNumer JOIN CDN.MagAdresy as A ON MgO_Id=MgA_MgOId where mag_gidnumer in (select man_magdnumer from cdn.magnag where man_gidnumer=@GidNumer)) set @wart='Nieznane'
INSERT INTO CDN.KolDokumenty(KDO_DokTyp, KDO_DokNumer, KDo_OpeNumer, KDo_OpeTyp, KDO_CzasWyslania, KDo_CzasOddania, KDo_Stan) VALUES(@GidTyp, @GidNumer, @OpeNumer, 128, datediff(ss,'19900101',getdate()), 0, 0)
if @GidTyp<>1602 begin select Twr_GIDNumer As TwrNumer, Twr_Kod as Towar, Twr_Nazwa as Nazwa ,map_ilosc as 'Ilosc',0.0000 as 'Ilosc Mag',twr_jm as 'Jm' ,isnull(CDN.PobierzMagAdres(MaP_MgAId),@wart) as 'Polozenie','' as 'Polozenie Mag' ,mae_cecha as Cecha ,isnull(SLW_WartoscS,'') as JednostkaLog ,Map_GidLp,Map_SubGidLp,mae_tpaid as Tpa_ID from cdn.magpelem left join cdn.slowniki on map_jednostkalog=slw_id join cdn.magelem on mae_gidnumer=map_gidnumer and mae_gidlp=map_gidlp join cdn.twrkarty on twr_gidnumer=mae_twrnumer where map_gidnumer=@gidnumer order by map_gidlp,map_subgidlp end else begin select Twr_GIDNumer As TwrNumer, Twr_Kod as Towar, Twr_Nazwa as Nazwa ,a.map_ilosc as 'Ilosc',0.0000 as 'Ilosc Mag',twr_jm as 'Jm' ,isnull(CDN.PobierzMagAdres(a.MaP_MgAId),@wart) as 'Polozenie','' as 'Polozenie Mag' ,isnull(CDN.PobierzMagAdres(b.MaP_MgAId),@wart) as 'Polozenie D' ,'' as 'Polozenie MagD' ,mae_cecha as Cecha,isnull(SLW_WartoscS,'') as JednostkaLog ,a.Map_GidLp,a.Map_SubGidLp,mae_tpaid as Tpa_ID from cdn.magpelem a left join cdn.slowniki on a.map_jednostkalog=slw_id join cdn.magelem on mae_gidnumer=a.map_gidnumer and mae_gidlp=a.map_gidlp join cdn.twrkarty on twr_gidnumer=mae_twrnumer join cdn.magpelem b on b.map_gidnumer=a.map_gidnumer and b.map_gidlp=a.map_gidlp and b.map_subgidlp<0 where a.map_gidnumer=@gidnumer and a.map_ilosc>0 order by a.map_gidlp,a.map_subgidlp end end else begin declare @zarzadz int if exists(SELECT * FROM CDN.Magazyny JOIN CDN.MagObszary ON Mgo_MagTyp = Mag_GidTyp AND Mgo_MagNumer = Mag_GidNumer JOIN CDN.MagAdresy as A ON MgO_Id=MgA_MgOId where mag_kod=@magkod) set @zarzadz=1 else set @zarzadz=0
if @GidTyp in (960,9344,9472,9473) begin select Twr_GIDNumer As TwrNumer, Twr_Kod as Towar, Twr_Nazwa as Nazwa ,(case when rez_ilosc is null then zae_ilosc-isnull(mas_ilosc,0) else rez_ilosc-rez_iloscmag end) as 'Ilość',twr_jm as 'Jm' ,0.0000 as 'Ilość Mag' ,(case when @zarzadz=0 then '<BRAK>' else 'Nieznane' end) as 'Położenie Mag' ,zae_cecha as 'Cecha','' as JednostkaLog,zae_gidnumer as Trn_GidNumer ,CDN.DokMapTypDokumentu (ZaN_GIDTyp,ZaN_ZamTyp,ZaN_Rodzaj) as Trn_GidTyp,zae_gidfirma as Trn_GidFirma,zae_gidlp as Tre_GidLp,0 as Trs_SubGidLp,-1 as Map_GidLp,-1 Map_SubGidLp ,isnull(dst_tpaid,-1) as Tpa_ID,zae_MagNumer as Mag_Numer from cdn.zamelem join cdn.zamnag on zae_gidnumer=zan_gidnumer join cdn.twrkarty on twr_gidnumer=zae_twrnumer left join cdn.rezerwacje on rez_zrdnumer=zae_gidnumer and zae_gidlp=rez_zrdlp and rez_gidtyp=2576 left join cdn.dostawy on rez_dstnumer=dst_gidnumer left join (select sum(mas_ilosc) as mas_ilosc,mas_twrnumer,mas_zlclp from cdn.magnag join cdn.magselem on MaN_GIDTyp=MaS_GIDTyp AND MaN_GIDNumer=MaS_GIDNumer where man_zrdnumer=@gidnumer and man_zrdtyp=960 group by mas_twrnumer,mas_zlclp ) m on mas_twrnumer=zae_twrnumer and mas_zlclp=zae_gidlp where zae_gidnumer=@gidnumer and zae_magnumer in (select mag_gidnumer from cdn.magazyny where mag_kod=@magkod) and (case when rez_ilosc is null then zae_ilosc-isnull(mas_ilosc,0) else rez_ilosc-rez_iloscmag end)>0 end else begin select Twr_GIDNumer As TwrNumer, Twr_Kod as Towar, Twr_Nazwa as Nazwa ,trs_ilosc-isnull(m.mas_ilosc,0) as 'Ilość',twr_jm as 'Jm' ,0.0000 as 'Ilość Mag' ,(case when @zarzadz=0 then '<BRAK>' else 'Nieznane' end) as 'Położenie Mag' ,dst_cecha as 'Cecha','' as JednostkaLog ,tre_gidnumer as Trn_GidNumer,tre_gidtyp as Trn_GidTyp,tre_gidfirma as Trn_GidFirma,Tre_GidLp,Trs_SubGidLp,-1 as Map_GidLp,-1 as Map_SubGidLp ,isnull(dst_tpaid,-1) as Tpa_ID,TrS_MagNumer as Mag_Numer from cdn.Traelem join cdn.Traselem on TrE_GIDTyp=TrS_GIDTyp AND TrE_GIDNumer=TrS_GIDNumer AND TrE_GIDLp=TrS_GIDLp join cdn.twrkarty on twr_gidnumer=tre_twrnumer left join cdn.dostawy on trs_dstnumer=dst_gidnumer left join (select mas_twrnumer,isnull(sum(mas_ilosc),0) as mas_ilosc,mas_zrdlp,mas_subzrdlp from cdn.magnag join cdn.magselem on MaN_GIDNumer=MaS_GIDNumer where man_zrdnumer=@gidnumer group by mas_twrnumer,mas_zrdlp,mas_subzrdlp) m on m.mas_twrnumer=tre_twrnumer and m.mas_zrdlp=trs_gidlp and mas_subzrdlp=trs_subgidlp where trs_ilosc-isnull(m.mas_ilosc,0)>0 and tre_gidnumer=@gidnumer and trs_magnumer in (select mag_gidnumer from cdn.magazyny where mag_kod=@magkod) end end END
